seo.title: Perplexity SEO: How to Get Cited by Perplexity AI
seo.meta_description: Perplexity SEO explained: how Perplexity picks and numbers its sources, how to let PerplexityBot crawl you, and how to write pages it cites again and again.

h1: Perplexity SEO: How to Get Your Site Cited by Perplexity
answer: Perplexity SEO is the work of getting your pages chosen as numbered sources in Perplexity's answers. Start by allowing PerplexityBot to crawl your site. Then publish fresh, specific pages that answer one question clearly, with facts and sources, so Perplexity's search can find them and its answer can quote them.
key_takeaways: Perplexity searches the web for almost every answer and shows its sources as numbered citations.
PerplexityBot must be allowed in robots.txt for your pages to be surfaced in Perplexity search.
Clear, specific, recently updated pages are cited most often.
Each citation is a visible, clickable link, which makes Perplexity traffic easy to measure.
The same work also helps ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Copilot.

sections.heading: How Perplexity builds an answer
sections.body_html:
Perplexity is built around citations. For most questions it runs a web search, reads the best-matching pages and writes an answer with numbered references that link to each source. Users can open the sources panel to see every page used.

That design makes Perplexity unusually transparent. You can see exactly who is cited for a question, which means you can study the winners and do better, and you can measure the visits Perplexity sends you.

sections.heading: Step 1: Let PerplexityBot crawl your site
sections.body_html:
Perplexity documents two user agents. PerplexityBot is designed to surface and link websites in Perplexity's search results, and Perplexity says it is not used to crawl content for training AI models. Perplexity-User fetches pages when a user's question needs them.

To be cited, allow PerplexityBot in robots.txt and make sure your firewall, CDN or security plugin does not block it. A simple rule looks like this:

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

Then check that your important pages are in your sitemap and load quickly with their main content in the HTML.

sections.heading: Step 2: Write pages Perplexity wants to cite
sections.body_html:
One question, answered early

Perplexity tends to cite pages that address the exact question rather than broad overviews. Give each important question its own page or section, and answer it in the first lines.

Specific facts with sources

Research on generative engines found that adding statistics, quotations and citations made sources more visible in AI-written answers. Name numbers, dates, methods and examples, and link to where they come from.

Freshness

Perplexity is often used for current questions. Keep key pages updated, show a clear "last updated" date, and refresh facts when they change.

Clean structure

Use headings that match follow-up questions, short paragraphs, lists and comparison tables. Each section should stand on its own if quoted.

sections.heading: Step 3: Build signals beyond your own site
sections.body_html:
Perplexity's search draws on the wider web, so where else your brand appears matters. Useful places to earn mentions include industry publications, directories, review platforms, community discussions such as Reddit, partner pages and podcasts with show notes. Consistent descriptions of what you do help Perplexity connect your brand to the right topics when it summarizes options.

Original data is especially powerful. A short survey, benchmark or price index that others reference gives Perplexity a unique fact that only your page can supply.

sections.heading: Study who Perplexity cites today
sections.body_html:
Because sources are visible, Perplexity SEO can start with research:

  1. List 20 questions your buyers ask.
  2. Ask each in Perplexity and record the cited domains.
  3. Open the top sources and note what they do well: length, structure, freshness, data, author details.
  4. Find questions where weak or outdated pages are cited. Those are your easiest wins.
  5. Publish or improve a page for each, then re-test after it is crawled.

Repeat monthly. Patterns usually appear quickly, such as Perplexity favoring certain publications or formats in your field.

Keep a simple spreadsheet with one row per question and columns for the date, the cited domains, whether you were cited, and the position of your citation. After two or three months it shows clearly which pages earn citations and which topics still need work.

sections.heading: Formats that get cited most on Perplexity
sections.body_html:
Some page formats are cited again and again because they match the way people use Perplexity:

  • Comparison pages such as "X vs Y", with a table of differences and a clear recommendation for each type of buyer.
  • How-to guides with numbered steps, prerequisites and common mistakes.
  • Definitions that explain a term in the first sentence and then give examples.
  • Buying guides listing selection criteria, price factors and questions to ask.
  • Original data such as surveys, benchmarks or price trackers that no other page can supply.

Pick the format that best matches each buyer question, rather than forcing every topic into a blog post.

sections.heading: How Perplexity SEO differs from Google SEO
sections.body_html:
Google ranks a list of pages and lets the searcher choose. Perplexity reads several pages and writes one answer, so it rewards different strengths:

Google SEOPerplexity SEO
Win conditionA high position in the resultsBeing one of the numbered sources
Best contentComprehensive pages that satisfy a keywordClear passages that answer one question precisely
FreshnessMatters for some topicsMatters for many, since users ask current questions
MeasurementRankings and clicksCitations per question and perplexity.ai referrals

The foundations still overlap: a crawlable, fast, trustworthy site with helpful content does well in both.

sections.heading: Measure Perplexity traffic
sections.body_html:
Perplexity citations are clickable links, so visits usually arrive with perplexity.ai as the referrer. In Google Analytics, include it in an "AI search" channel with chatgpt.com, gemini.google.com, copilot.microsoft.com and claude.ai. Track which landing pages it sends visitors to and whether they submit your forms.

Visitors from Perplexity are often in research mode and have already read a summary, so a clear next step, such as an audit offer or a short form, matters on every page they land on.

sections.body_html:

faqs.a: It is the practice of getting your pages cited as sources in Perplexity's answers. It combines letting PerplexityBot crawl your site, writing specific and up-to-date pages that answer one question clearly, and earning mentions on sites Perplexity's search trusts.

Add a rule to robots.txt such as 'User-agent: PerplexityBot' followed by 'Allow: /', and check that your firewall, CDN or security plugin does not block it. Perplexity says PerplexityBot is used to surface sites in search results, not to train models.

faqs.q: Why does Perplexity cite my competitors and not me?
faqs.a: Their pages usually answer the exact question more directly, include more specific facts or are more recently updated. Open the cited sources, compare them with your page and close the gaps.

faqs.q: How fast can Perplexity cite a new page?
faqs.a: Because Perplexity searches the web for most answers, a well-structured page can be cited soon after it is discovered and crawled. Sitemaps, internal links and IndexNow help it get found faster.

faqs.q: Does Perplexity SEO help with ChatGPT and Google too?
faqs.a: Yes. Crawl access, direct answers, sourced facts, clean structure and brand mentions help every engine that builds answers from the web, including ChatGPT search, Google AI Overviews and Copilot.

faqs.q: Can I measure traffic from Perplexity?
faqs.a: Yes. Visits from Perplexity citations usually show perplexity.ai as the referrer in Google Analytics. Track them as part of an AI search channel and compare their lead rate with other sources.
